## Editable network graph powered by Pyodide, D3, and Observable Plot

This Quarto document lets you edit a Python graph script and renders a networkx-style graph in the browser.

The editor supports a small NetworkX-like API:

- `G = nx.Graph()`
- `G.add_node(name)`
- `G.add_edge(u, v, weight=1)`
- `G.nodes()`
- `G.edges()`
- `G.degree(node)`

```{=html}
<div id="graph-ui">
  <div id="graph-editor">
    <label for="python-editor"><strong>Edit Python graph code</strong></label>
    <textarea id="python-editor" rows="14">import json

G = nx.Graph()
G.add_edge("Alice", "Bob")
G.add_edge("Bob", "Carol")
G.add_edge("Carol", "Dave")
G.add_edge("Alice", "Dave")
G.add_edge("Bob", "Eve")
G.add_edge("Eve", "Frank")
G.add_edge("Frank", "Carol")

# Optional: inspect or modify the graph
print("nodes:", list(G.nodes()))
print("edges:", list(G.edges()))

# The renderer uses G if graph_output is not defined.
# You can also set graph_output manually to a JSON structure.
</textarea>
    <div class="button-row">
      <button id="run-code">Run Python</button>
      <button id="reset-code">Reset code</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="graph-output">
    <div id="graph-area">
      <svg id="graph-svg" aria-label="Network graph" width="760" height="520"></svg>
    </div>
    <div id="chart-area">
      <div id="degree-chart"></div>
    </div>
    <div id="py-output"></div>
  </div>
</div>
```

```{=html}
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7.9.0/dist/d3.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@observablehq/plot@0.6.2/dist/plot.umd.js"></script>
<script type="module">
const Plot = window.Plot;
const d3 = window.d3;
import {loadPyodide} from "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/pyodide/v0.25.0/full/pyodide.mjs";

let pyodide = null;

function normalizeGraph(graph) {
  const nodeMap = new Map();
  const links = Array.isArray(graph.links) ? graph.links : [];

  links.forEach(link => {
    const source = String(link.source);
    const target = String(link.target);
    const weight = Number(link.weight ?? 1) || 1;

    if (!nodeMap.has(source)) nodeMap.set(source, { id: source, degree: 0 });
    if (!nodeMap.has(target)) nodeMap.set(target, { id: target, degree: 0 });

    nodeMap.get(source).degree += 1;
    nodeMap.get(target).degree += 1;
  });

  const nodes = Array.from(nodeMap.values());
  return { nodes, links: links.map(link => ({ source: String(link.source), target: String(link.target), weight: Number(link.weight ?? 1) || 1 })) };
}

function renderDegreePlot(nodes, container) {
  container.innerHTML = "";

  if (!nodes.length) {
    container.textContent = "No graph data available yet.";
    return;
  }

  const plot = Plot.plot({
    width: 760,
    height: 240,
    x: {
      label: "Node",
      tickRotate: -25
    },
    y: {
      label: "Degree"
    },
    marks: [
      Plot.bar(nodes, { x: "id", y: "degree", fill: "#1f77b4" }),
      Plot.ruleY([0])
    ]
  });

  container.appendChild(plot);
}

function renderNetwork(graph, svgElement) {
  svgElement.innerHTML = "";
  const width = Number(svgElement.getAttribute("width") || 760);
  const height = Number(svgElement.getAttribute("height") || 520);

  if (!graph.nodes.length) {
    const placeholder = document.createElement("text");
    placeholder.setAttribute("x", width / 2);
    placeholder.setAttribute("y", height / 2);
    placeholder.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
    placeholder.setAttribute("fill", "#666");
    placeholder.textContent = "Run Python code to render the graph.";
    svgElement.appendChild(placeholder);
    return;
  }

  const svg = d3.select(svgElement)
    .attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${width} ${height}`)
    .attr("preserveAspectRatio", "xMidYMid meet");

  const link = svg.append("g")
    .attr("stroke", "#999")
    .attr("stroke-opacity", 0.6)
    .selectAll("line")
    .data(graph.links)
    .join("line")
    .attr("stroke-width", d => Math.max(1, Math.min(4, d.weight || 1)));

  const node = svg.append("g")
    .attr("stroke", "#222")
    .attr("stroke-width", 1.5)
    .selectAll("g")
    .data(graph.nodes)
    .join("g")
    .call(d3.drag()
      .on("start", dragstarted)
      .on("drag", dragged)
      .on("end", dragended));

  node.append("circle")
    .attr("r", d => 8 + Math.min(d.degree * 2, 14))
    .attr("fill", "#1f77b4");

  node.append("text")
    .attr("x", 12)
    .attr("y", 4)
    .attr("font-size", "0.9rem")
    .attr("fill", "#222")
    .text(d => d.id);

  node.append("title")
    .text(d => `${d.id}: degree ${d.degree}`);

  const simulation = d3.forceSimulation(graph.nodes)
    .force("link", d3.forceLink(graph.links).id(d => d.id).distance(120).strength(0.4))
    .force("charge", d3.forceManyBody().strength(-320))
    .force("center", d3.forceCenter(width / 2, height / 2))
    .force("collide", d3.forceCollide().radius(d => 16 + Math.min(d.degree * 2, 12)));

  simulation.on("tick", () => {
    link
      .attr("x1", d => Math.max(0, Math.min(width, d.source.x)))
      .attr("y1", d => Math.max(0, Math.min(height, d.source.y)))
      .attr("x2", d => Math.max(0, Math.min(width, d.target.x)))
      .attr("y2", d => Math.max(0, Math.min(height, d.target.y)));

    node.attr("transform", d => {
      d.x = Math.max(16, Math.min(width - 16, d.x));
      d.y = Math.max(16, Math.min(height - 16, d.y));
      return `translate(${d.x},${d.y})`;
    });
  });

  function dragstarted(event, d) {
    if (!event.active) simulation.alphaTarget(0.3).restart();
    d.fx = d.x;
    d.fy = d.y;
  }

  function dragged(event, d) {
    d.fx = event.x;
    d.fy = event.y;
  }

  function dragended(event, d) {
    if (!event.active) simulation.alphaTarget(0);
    d.fx = null;
    d.fy = null;
  }
}

async function runPythonCode(code, output) {
  output.textContent = "Running Python...";
  pyodide.globals.set("code_input", code);

  const python = `
import json
from types import SimpleNamespace

class Graph:
    def __init__(self):
        self.adj = {}

    def add_node(self, node):
        self.adj.setdefault(node, {})

    def add_edge(self, u, v, weight=1):
        self.add_node(u)
        self.add_node(v)
        self.adj[u][v] = {"weight": weight}
        self.adj[v][u] = {"weight": weight}

    def nodes(self):
        return list(self.adj.keys())

    def edges(self):
        seen = set()
        edges = []
        for u, nbrs in self.adj.items():
            for v, data in nbrs.items():
                if (v, u) in seen:
                    continue
                seen.add((u, v))
                edges.append((u, v, data.get("weight", 1)))
        return edges

    def degree(self, node=None):
        if node is None:
            return {n: len(self.adj[n]) for n in self.adj}
        return len(self.adj.get(node, {}))

class NX:
    Graph = Graph

nx = NX()

globals().update({"code_input": code_input})
exec(code_input, globals())

if "graph_output" in globals():
    result = graph_output
elif "G" in globals() and hasattr(G, "edges") and hasattr(G, "nodes"):
    result = {
        "nodes": [{"id": n, "degree": G.degree(n)} for n in G.nodes()],
        "links": [{"source": u, "target": v, "weight": w} for u, v, w in G.edges()]
    }
else:
    result = {"nodes": [], "links": []}

json.dumps(result)
`;

  try {
    const result = await pyodide.runPythonAsync(python);
    return JSON.parse(result.trim());
  } finally {
    pyodide.globals.delete("code_input");
  }
}

window.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", async () => {
  const editor = document.getElementById("python-editor");
  const svgElement = document.getElementById("graph-svg");
  const chartContainer = document.getElementById("degree-chart");
  const output = document.getElementById("py-output");
  const runButton = document.getElementById("run-code");
  const resetButton = document.getElementById("reset-code");

  const defaultCode = editor.value.trim();

  runButton.addEventListener("click", async () => {
    try {
      const graph = normalizeGraph(await runPythonCode(editor.value, output));
      renderNetwork(graph, svgElement);
      renderDegreePlot(graph.nodes, chartContainer);
      output.textContent = "Python executed and graph rendered.";
    } catch (error) {
      output.textContent = `Error: ${error}`;
    }
  });

  resetButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
    editor.value = defaultCode;
    output.textContent = "Code reset. Run Python to update the graph.";
  });

  output.textContent = "Loading Pyodide…";
  pyodide = await loadPyodide({ indexURL: "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/pyodide/v0.25.0/full/" });
  output.textContent = "Pyodide ready. Run Python to render the graph.";
  runButton.click();
});
</script>
